title: Know When to Abstain: Conformal Confidence Estimation for Text-to-SQL
abstract: arXiv:2611.31190v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Text-to-SQL systems often return queries that execute successfully but answer the wrong question. Detecting these errors at deployment is hard because execution correctness is defined against a gold query, which exists only in labeled data. We formulate confidence estimation for Text-to-SQL as probabilistic query validation under a latent correctness variable that is observable at calibration time through gold-SQL execution and latent at deployment. Our estimator separates generation from validation. A generator LLM writes and executes the query, and a different critic LLM judges the query and its execution result. The critic's validation and execution-grounded alignment scores are fused with the generator's verbalized confidence, token-level uncertainty, and SQL-structural features in a Random Forest, using two sequential LLM calls. translated_title: 知道何时弃答：面向Text-to-SQL的共形置信度估计
translated_abstract: Text-to-SQL系统常常返回能够成功执行、却回答了错误问题的查询。在部署阶段检测这类错误十分困难，因为执行正确性是相对于标准查询（gold query）来定义的，而标准查询只存在于有标注的数据中。我们将Text-to-SQL的置信度估计形式化为概率化查询验证问题，其中存在一个潜在的正确性变量：在校准阶段可以通过gold-SQL的执行结果被观测到，而在部署阶段则是潜在的、不可观测的。我们的估计器将生成与验证分离开来：由生成器LLM编写并执行查询，再由另一个不同的批评者（critic）LLM对查询及其执行结果进行评判。批评者给出的验证得分与基于执行结果的对齐得分，会同生成器的口头化置信度、token级不确定性以及SQL结构特征一起，通过随机森林进行融合，整个过程仅需两次顺序LLM调用。两个校准步骤提供了有限样本保证。通过“先学习后测试”确定的阈值能够确保，以……（摘要原文在此处被截断，后续内容缺失）
tldr: 该论文将Text-to-SQL的置信度估计形式化为潜在正确性变量下的概率化查询验证，通过生成器与批评者LLM分离、随机森林融合多源信号，并以共形校准提供有限样本保证，使系统能够判断何时应对查询结果弃答。
en_tdlr: This paper formulates Text-to-SQL confidence estimation as probabilistic query validation under a latent correctness variable, separating generation from validation with a critic LLM and Random Forest fusion of multi-source signals, and leveraging conformal calibration to provide finite-sample guarantees for knowing when to abstain.
